# kimi-for-copilot

Kimi (Moonshot AI) models for GitHub Copilot Chat — BYOK, with visible thinking and balance monitoring.

- Docs: docs/kimi-api.md
- Harness: docs/copilot-harness.md
- README: README.md
- API reference (Kimi): https://platform.kimi.ai/docs

Copilot agent harness: options.tools forwarded with [a-zA-Z0-9_-] name sanitization + back-mapping; toolMode Auto→tool_choice auto, Required→required on kimi-k3 only (others degrade to auto); image tool results annotated as omitted; see docs/copilot-harness.md
